I need to identify the specific mechanism in this quotation: "Best Start Family Hubs" — these are publicly provided support centers for parents with young children, focused on early childhood/family welfare support services.

The specific instrument is: community-based family support hubs providing services to parents (early years support, parenting support). This is about welfare/well-being services for families with young children.

- I3 (Welfare, Well-Being, and Poverty) fits because these are welfare support services for families
- I2 (Education) could apply if these hubs have an early childhood education component, but the statement emphasizes "support" for parents broadly
- H4 (Publicly Provided Goods) — the hubs are publicly provided services, but the rule says not to classify by instrument when the area is the substance

The primary content is about family welfare support services — this fits best under I3 (Welfare, Well-Being, and Poverty), as Family Hubs are social support infrastructure for families.

A secondary consideration: J1 (Demographic Economics) covers family economics and early childhood, but I3 is more directly about welfare services. D1 (Household Behavior and Family Economics) could also apply since this is about family support.

Primary: I (Health, Education, and Welfare) — specifically I3 for welfare/well-being services for families.
Secondary: None strongly justified beyond this.
